record: S5.2b, S5.4c and the optionAdvance test of docs/roadmap/19-ai-strategy-improvement-wbs.md: each weight of the S5 candidate, and optionAdvance, alone against heuristic@86; the weights with a positive VP effect make cand2, which is then estimated as in S5.2. Written before any continuation is run
request: The user (2026-11-16), on the S5.2 options: 「2+3」 (2: the attacker's option choice, bot-option-retreat-advance; 3: S5.2b part split and S5.4c, the defender parts)
build: source commit 14719f7 (optionAdvance), dist built from it, Node v26.9.0
baseline: heuristic@86's rows of S5.2 (artifacts/ai-s5/s52/{west,east,reused}); same branches, dice seeds and opponent, so they are not run again
branches: S5.2's (docs/quality/evidence/ai-s5-vp-check-2026-11-15), split by role into branches-{west,east}-{attacker,defender}.jsonl and branches-east-s47-attacker.jsonl (this folder): Western 229 + 229 (1 dice), Eastern 39 + 39 new and 14 + 14 S4.7 branches (2 dice)
reuse: For the 28 S4.7 Eastern branches, S4.7's approach, arrival and bridge rows (attacker) and cut, approach and arrival rows (defender) are copied to artifacts/ai-s5/s52b/reused: the same weights, and in attack engagements S4.7's build decides as this one; their results were seen in S4.7. opt is run on them
commands: cand2 on all S5.2 branches: node scripts/ai-continue-batch.mjs --branches <S5.2 branches-west.jsonl> --variant cand2=heuristic:$F/cand2-weights.json $O --dice 1 --out-dir artifacts/ai-s5/s52c/west; the same for branches-east.jsonl and branches-east-s47.jsonl with --dice 2 into artifacts/ai-s5/s52c/east
continuations: parts: Western 229 x 4 + 229 x 3 = 1,603; Eastern 39 x 4 x 2 + 39 x 3 x 2 + 14 x 2 = 574; 2,177 in all (about 7 hours). cand2: 458 + 106 x 2 = 670 (about 2.2 hours)
measure: margin.vp at the end of the game, variant - v86, dice averaged per branch; SE over maps (ai-continue-compare.py --by-style --by-role --cluster-by-map). Objectives margin and Kill - Loss reported

estimates.role effect: (Western + Eastern) / 2 of the weight in that role
estimates.pair effect: (the sum of the role effects where the weight acts) / 2: the weight's contribution to an attack pair of an independent batch; a role where the weight does not act contributes 0

selection: A weight enters cand2 when its pair effect is above 0 (S5.4c of the plan: keep the parts with positive VP). Weights act on both roles where they act; splitting a weight by role is not done here (it needs code). If no weight is kept, S5 stops and the result goes to the user
expectedPrecision: a role effect about 0.53 (S5.2's cells: Western about 0.77, Eastern about 0.73); a pair effect about 0.27 for a one-role weight and 0.37 for a two-role one. A weight with no effect is kept with probability 0.5; one at -0.3 a pair with probability 0.13 to 0.21. Whether a weight's effect is established (mean - 2.1 SE > 0) is reported but does not decide
cand2 reading: as S5.2: pass probability at pair SD 3.7 and 4.5 from the estimate (Western attacker + Western defender + Eastern attacker + Eastern defender) / 4 and its SE; both >= 0.8 recommends registering S5.3 (its games need the user's consent); a cell established worse is fixed first; otherwise the probabilities go to the user
cand2's weights were selected on these same branches, so its estimate is biased upward; the independent batch is the unbiased test. The estimate without the 28 S4.7 branches is reported
if cand2 has the same weights as S5.2's candidate, S5.2's estimate stands and cand2 is not run
limits: The selection rule keeps a weight with no effect half the time
optionAdvance was found in a census of 68 games, 40 of them Western games of 2100400-479, which are not among these branches; 14 of the Eastern games are census games (heuristic@86 self-play)
